payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn home project questions into real progress with Thumbtack.
Ask about home repairs, maintenance, or upgrades and get matched with the right local pros without leaving the conversation. payload.name: Love and Lemons

payload.name: RealAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

RealAI doesn't just describe properties and places — it scores and ranks them. Every area and building carries normalized national and local benchmarks across hundreds of attributes, so RealAI can rank an entire population — markets, neighborhoods, or buildings — against any combination of criteria a user cares about, rather than profiling one place at a time off a fixed template.

探索印度数量最多、经过质量检查的二手车库存，或在线浏览并比较新车。
在 Cars24，你可以购买经过详细检测并附有报告的二手车，享受无需繁琐文书、灵活融资、行业领先的保修、便捷退车以及端到端 RC 过户服务。
连接 Cars24，体验顺畅无忧的购车过程。

payload.name: Belk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This plug helps to shop Belk for fashion, shoes, beauty, handbags, jewelry, and home. Discover deals, browse top brands, find products, and get personalized shopping help.
payload.longDescription: 这个插件帮助你在 Belk 选购时装、鞋履、美妆、手袋、珠宝和家居用品。发现优惠、浏览顶级品牌、寻找产品，并获得个性化购物帮助。

payload.name: Imovirtual
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your next home in Portugal — just describe it. With Imovirtual, describe what you're looking for and we'll show you the listings that match — "3-bedroom house near good schools under €300k" or "modern apartment for rent downtown with parking."

Key features:
- Search for your ideal property in natural language
- Get matched listings for sale and rent
- Ask follow-up questions to narrow your search
- Get detailed information on any listing and compare options
- Explore results on an interactive map
payload.longDescription:
只需描述需求，即可在葡萄牙找到下一处住所。使用 Imovirtual 描述你想找的房子，我们就会展示符合条件的房源，例如“靠近好学校、售价低于 €300k 的3-bedroom（3 居室）住宅”或“市中心带停车位的现代出租公寓”。

主要功能：
- 使用自然语言搜索理想房产
- 获取待售和出租的匹配房源
- 通过追问缩小搜索范围
- 查看房源详情并比较选项
- 在交互式地图上浏览结果

payload.name: Experian Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Experian Insurance lets users explore auto insurance pricing directly inside ChatGPT. Experian Members can connect their Experian account to ChatGPT and get personalized insurance offers based on their profile and additional driver, vehicle, and coverage details. All users can get geographically based insurance estimates from Experian’s trusted carrier network by entering a 5-digit U.S. ZIP code. These estimates are not final prices, but localized starting points for comparison. Users can seamlessly continue to Experian to view bindable quotes and complete their purchase securely.
payload.longDescription: Experian Insurance 让用户可以直接在 ChatGPT 中了解汽车保险价格。Experian 会员可以将 Experian 账户连接到 ChatGPT，根据个人资料及其他驾驶员、车辆和保障详情获取个性化保险报价。所有用户都可以输入美国 5 位邮政编码，根据所在地从 Experian 可信的承保机构网络获取保险估价。这些估价不是最终价格，而是供比较参考的本地起始价。用户可以顺畅地前往 Experian 查看可投保报价，并安全完成购买。

payload.name: Figaro Immobilier
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search the Figaro Immobilier database to find properties that match your search criteria (location, budget, property type, size, buy/rent).
payload.longDescription: 在 Figaro Immobilier 数据库中搜索符合条件的房产，可按地点、预算、房产类型、面积以及购买或租赁等条件筛选。

payload.name: CarWale
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CarWale is India's most trusted platform for car research and discovery, empowering buyers to make confident, informed decisions.
Explore detailed prices, technical specifications, and features across hundreds of new car models - all in one place. Read expert reviews and real user opinions to understand how a car performs in everyday conditions. Compare models side by side to find the one that truly fits your needs and budget.
Browse the latest offers and deals from authorised dealers in your area. From initial research to final decision, CarWale is your complete car-buying companion.
payload.longDescription:
CarWale 是印度最值得信赖的汽车研究与发现平台，帮助购车者自信、明智地做出决定。
在一个地方探索数百款新车的详细价格、技术规格和功能。阅读专家评测和真实用户意见，了解汽车在日常情况下的表现。并排比较不同车型，找到真正符合需求和预算的选择。
浏览你所在地区授权经销商的最新优惠和促销。从初步研究到最终决定，CarWale 都是你的全程购车伙伴。

payload.name: Vaktim
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vaktim helps users look up Quran verses, read short verse explanations, find Quran verses by topic or mood, fetch surah previews, and retrieve city-based Islamic prayer times with links back to the Vaktim app and website.
payload.longDescription: Vaktim 帮助用户查找古兰经经文、阅读简短的经文释义、按主题或心情查找经文、获取苏拉预览，以及查询按城市提供的伊斯兰礼拜时间，并附有返回 Vaktim 应用和网站的链接。

payload.name: DoneDeal
payload.description: 查找最新的新车和二手车
payload.summaryOriginal: Find the most new & used cars
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the exact car you need - and you’ll love to drive - with DoneDeal + ChatGPT.
'@DoneDeal, find me an automatic hybrid for around €50k in Dublin from a trusted car dealer'
Done.

Whether you're buying your first car, upgrading the family runaround, or looking for something a bit special, you can search DoneDeal in ChatGPT using simple, conversational prompts such as: 'Show me SUVs with a big boot', 'What’s available in Dublin right now?' or 'Show me cars under €60,000 near me.'

Why It’s Different
- The DoneDeal app is home to the widest selection of both new and used cars available for sale from dealerships and private sellers in Ireland
- Is deeply integrated with DoneDeal’s live inventory with unique car data.
- Understands Irish car-buying context
- Replaces friction-heavy filters with conversation
- Ask Feature to help you learn, compare and see similar cars
payload.longDescription:
通过 DoneDeal + ChatGPT，找到你需要、也会爱上驾驶的那辆车。
'@DoneDeal，帮我在都柏林找一辆约 50,000 欧元、来自可信汽车经销商的自动挡混合动力车。'
完成。

无论你是首次购车、想给家里换一辆日常用车，还是在寻找特别的车型，都可以在 ChatGPT 中用简单的对话提示搜索 DoneDeal，例如：“给我看看后备箱大的 SUV”“现在都柏林有哪些车？”或“给我看看我附近 60,000 欧元以下的车。”

它有何不同
- DoneDeal 应用汇集了爱尔兰经销商和私人卖家出售的新车和二手车，车型选择最广
- 与 DoneDeal 实时库存及独家车辆数据深度集成
- 理解爱尔兰当地的购车情境
- 用对话搜索取代繁琐的筛选器
- 可使用 Ask 功能了解信息、比较车辆并查看相似车型

payload.name: Zumper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover your ideal rental home across the US and Canada with Zumper. Tell us what matters to you - whether it's in-unit laundry, pet-friendly policies, or parking - and we'll surface places that match your specific needs. Browse apartments, houses, and condos with detailed listings, then compare local rent data to ensure you're getting fair market value. From studio apartments in downtown neighborhoods to family homes in the suburbs, Zumper helps you search smarter and move in with confidence.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Zumper 在美国和加拿大寻找理想出租房。告诉我们你在意什么——例如室内洗衣设施、是否允许养宠物或停车位——我们就会为你筛选符合具体需求的房源。浏览包含详细信息的公寓、独栋房和共管公寓，并比较当地租金数据，确保租金符合公平市场价值。从市中心街区的单间公寓到郊区的家庭住宅，Zumper 帮助你更聪明地寻找房源，并安心入住。

payload.name: Immobiliare.it
payload.description: 意大利 No. 1 房屋买卖平台
payload.summaryOriginal: The N.1 for selling and buying
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Immobiliare.it app, Italy’s No. 1 real estate classifieds platform, is the best way to find the perfect home for you.

Browse thousands of listings for homes for sale, for rent, and at auction in Rome, Milan, Naples, Turin, Genoa, Bologna, Florence, as well as in many other cities and small towns across Italy.

Find the perfect home for you
• Choose a city, neighborhood, or location, or draw your search area directly on the map.
• Filter listings by price, size, number of rooms, and the features you are looking for.
• Save your favorite listings, hide the ones you are less interested in, and add personal notes.
• Get app and email notifications for new listings or price changes by saving your search.
• Easily find your saved searches and listings again thanks to synchronization across the app, website, and all your devices.
payload.longDescription:
Immobiliare.it 是意大利排名 No. 1 的房地产分类信息平台，帮助你找到理想住所。

浏览罗马、米兰、那不勒斯、都灵、热那亚、博洛尼亚、佛罗伦萨以及意大利其他城市和小镇中数千套待售、出租和拍卖房源。

找到理想住所
• 选择城市、街区或地点，或直接在地图上绘制搜索区域。
• 按价格、面积、房间数和所需特色筛选房源。
• 收藏心仪房源、隐藏不感兴趣的房源，并添加个人备注。
• 保存搜索，即可通过应用和电子邮件接收新房源或价格变动通知。
• 房源和搜索记录在应用、网站及所有设备间同步，方便随时找到。

payload.name: Cara
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your next car from over 95% of vehicles actively for sale in the U.S. 

Search by specific features like heated seats, Apple CarPlay, or panoramic roof — or use lifestyle tags like "family-friendly," "first car," or "pet-friendly" to match how you actually live. View specs, photos, dealer info, and payment estimates for any vehicle.

Try asking things like: 
• Find me a reliable SUV under $35k with leather seats and a quiet cabin. 
• Show me family-friendly cars with Apple CarPlay and good safety ratings.
payload.longDescription:
从美国市场上超过 95% 正在出售的车辆中找到下一辆车。

按加热座椅、Apple CarPlay 或全景车顶等具体功能搜索，也可以使用“适合家庭”“第一辆车”或“适合宠物”等生活方式标签，以匹配您的真实生活。查看任意车辆的规格、照片、经销商信息和付款估算。

您可以问：
• 帮我找一辆 35,000 美元以下、配真皮座椅且车内安静的可靠 SUV。
• 展示配备 Apple CarPlay 且安全评级良好的家庭用车。

payload.name: The Knot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find top-rated wedding vendors and venues that can bring your wedding to life. Browse photos, reviews, offerings and other key details that help you quickly compare options and build the right team for your kind of vibe.
payload.longDescription: 寻找评价出色、能让你的婚礼梦想成真的婚礼服务商和场地。浏览照片、评论、服务内容及其他关键信息，快速比较选项，并组建符合你风格的团队。

payload.name: WebAZ Shopping
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and compare operator-reviewed everyday physical products in clear cards. See current prices, availability, delivery estimates, return terms, and key product facts, then ask ChatGPT to compare results or help you choose. Open a product on WebAZ to view its full listing and continue there if you want. Discovery requires no login, and the plugin cannot create orders or process payments.
payload.longDescription: 以清晰卡片形式查找并比较经运营方审核的日常实体商品。查看当前价格、库存情况、预计配送时间、退货条款和主要商品信息，然后让 ChatGPT 比较结果或协助选择。打开 WebAZ 上的商品即可查看完整商品页，并可选择在那里继续操作。浏览无需登录，插件不能创建订单或处理付款。

payload.name: Catholic Index
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up Catholic parishes, Mass times, Confession schedules, and Adoration hours near any location. Get full parish details. Find Masses currently livestreaming on YouTube. Search recorded homilies by topic using semantic search. Get daily Mass readings with liturgical info and a reflection, in English or Spanish. Covers 23,000+ US parishes.
payload.longDescription: 查询任意地点附近的天主教堂区、弥撒时间、告解安排和朝拜时段。查看堂区完整信息。查找当前正在 YouTube 上直播的弥撒。通过语义搜索按主题查找已录制的讲道。查看每日弥撒读经内容及礼仪信息和灵修反思，支持英语或西班牙语。覆盖美国 23,000 多个堂区。

payload.name: Tixel
payload.description: 演出与体育赛事转售门票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tixel helps users search upcoming concerts, festivals, sports games, and shows on the Tixel marketplace, compare available ticket listings, and inspect listing details before continuing purchase on tixel.com.
payload.longDescription: Tixel 帮助用户在 Tixel 市场搜索即将举行的演唱会、音乐节、体育比赛和演出，比较可购买的门票刊登信息，并在前往 tixel.com 继续购买前查看刊登详情。

payload.name: motos.net
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access the motos.net marketplace to search for new, used, and classic motorbikes. This app allows you to filter listings by make, model, price, year, and location. Users can retrieve current motorbike listings, view technical details, and compare different vehicle options directly through chat.
payload.longDescription: 访问 motos.net 市场，搜索新款、二手和经典摩托车。可按品牌、型号、价格、年份和位置筛选列表。用户可直接在聊天中获取当前摩托车列表、查看技术详情并比较不同车辆选项。

payload.name: Liftosaur
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Liftosaur is a scriptable workout app. It uses language "Liftoscript" to define workouts. The plugin lets users to write and manage Liftoscript programs, workout history, exercises, gym equipment, measurements, etc.

Free reference tools provide Liftoscript syntax, examples, program design guidance, built-in programs, and exercise names.

Private account tools require the user to authenticate with Liftosaur and have an active subscription before reading or changing programs, history, gyms, equipment, exercise settings, or measurements.
payload.longDescription:
Liftosaur 是一款可编程训练应用，使用名为“Liftoscript”的语言定义训练。该插件允许用户编写和管理 Liftoscript 程序、训练历史、动作、健身房器材、测量数据等。

免费的参考工具提供 Liftoscript 语法、示例、训练计划设计指导、内置计划和动作名称。

私有账户工具要求用户向 Liftosaur 完成身份验证并拥有有效订阅，之后才能读取或修改训练计划、历史、健身房、器材、动作设置或测量数据。

payload.name: Le Parisien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Accédez aux informations du Parisien : retrouvez les dernières actualités, recherchez des articles et suivez nos directs des grands événements facilement depuis ChatGPT.

Une façon simple et rapide de rester informé de l’actualité avec Le Parisien
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中访问 Le Parisien 新闻：轻松获取最新消息、搜索文章，并关注重大事件的实时报道。

通过 Le Parisien，以简单快捷的方式了解最新资讯。

payload.name: UltraFit360
payload.description: 你的 AI 健身教练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UltraFit360 connects ChatGPT to your personal fitness and nutrition data. Ask what you ate this week, how your weight is trending, what workouts you logged, or for a full progress report — answers come straight from your UltraFit360 food diary, workout logs, body metrics, and AI coaching memory. With your confirmation, it can also log the meals you eat, adjust your daily calorie, macro, water and step targets, plan meals, swap exercises, and assign or build workout programs. Your identity comes solely from your authenticated session, so the app only ever accesses your own data. UltraFit360 is operated by Aptix Labs Private Limited; see https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy for how connector data is handled.
payload.longDescription: UltraFit360 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的个人健身和营养数据。你可以询问本周吃了什么、体重趋势如何、记录了哪些训练，或索取完整进展报告；回答直接来自 UltraFit360 饮食日记、训练记录、身体指标和 AI 教练记忆。经你确认后，它还可以记录你吃过的餐食、调整每日卡路里、宏量营养素、饮水量和步数目标、规划餐食、更换训练动作，以及分配或创建训练计划。你的身份完全依据已验证的登录会话，因此应用只会访问你自己的数据。UltraFit360 由 Aptix Labs Private Limited 运营；有关连接器数据的处理方式，请参阅 https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy。

payload.name: GrailPeople Shopping
payload.description: 查找真实可信的产品评价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search 7,000+ skincare, makeup, and hair products by ingredient, concern, or skin type, and get shopping recommendations. GrailPeople shows what beauty experts actually say, including estheticians, makeup artists, and beauty content creators. Every review comes with quotes, video timestamps, and creator credentials.
payload.longDescription: 按成分、关注问题或肤质搜索 7,000 多种护肤、彩妆和护发产品，并获取购物建议。GrailPeople 展示美容专家的真实观点，包括美容师、化妆师和美容内容创作者。每条评价都附有引述、视频时间戳和创作者资历。

payload.name: Able.Style
payload.description: 适应各种天气的穿搭灵感
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Able.Style is a personal fashion and style assistant that helps you decide what to wear using clothes from your own closet, the occasion, and local weather conditions.

Ask questions like “What should I wear today?”, “What should I wear for a casual work day?” or “What outfit works for cold and rainy weather?” Get complete outfit ideas with specific clothing items and visual fashion inspiration for work, weekends, events, hot weather, cold weather, rain, and changing forecasts.

Weather-aware outfit recommendations use the location saved in your Able.Style account when you’re signed in, or the location you share with ChatGPT. You can also choose your preferred temperature and wind speed units.

When you sign in, you can add clothes you own to your closet and like or dislike outfits to refine future style suggestions. Able.Style personalizes fashion recommendations based on your wardrobe and past preferences.

It’s a simple way to save time, avoid outfit guesswork, develop your personal style, and make better use of the clothes you already have.
payload.longDescription:
Able.Style 是个人时尚与穿搭助手，根据你的衣橱、场合和当地天气情况，帮助你决定穿什么。

可以询问“今天该穿什么？”、“休闲工作日该穿什么？”或“寒冷多雨的天气适合什么搭配？”。获取包含具体单品的完整穿搭建议和视觉时尚灵感，适用于工作、周末、活动、炎热、寒冷、下雨以及变化中的天气预报。

结合天气的穿搭建议会在你登录时使用 Able.Style 账号中保存的位置，或使用你向 ChatGPT 提供的位置。你还可以选择偏好的温度和风速单位。

登录后，你可以将已有衣物添加到衣橱，并对搭配点赞或点踩，优化未来的穿搭建议。Able.Style 根据你的衣橱和以往偏好提供个性化时尚推荐。

这是一种简单的方法，帮你节省时间、避免猜测搭配、发展个人风格，并更充分地利用已有衣物。

payload.name: Rakhys
payload.description: 查找最佳电子产品价格
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rakhys helps users compare electronics prices across major online stores in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.

The app brings together product prices, specifications, and availability in one place, making it easier to find the best option before purchasing.

Rakhys provides:

Daily updated prices from multiple online retailers

Clear comparison of product specifications

AI-powered recommendations based on user needs

A simple and fast interface for smart shopping decisions

Rakhys is designed to save users time and money by helping them make informed buying decisions.
payload.longDescription:
该插件查找最佳电子产品价格。以下功能和限制适用：

Rakhys helps users compare electronics prices across major online stores in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.

The app brings together product prices, specifications, and availability in one place, making it easier to find the best option before purchasing.

Rakhys provides:

Daily updated prices from multiple online retailers

Clear comparison of product specifications

AI-powered recommendations based on user needs

A simple and fast interface for smart shopping decisions
Rakhys is designed to save users time and money by helping them make informed buying decisions.

payload.name: Standvirtual
payload.description: 在 Standvirtual 寻找理想座驾
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your dream car in Portugal using everyday language. Skip the complex filters and search forms. With Standvirtual, simply describe what you're looking for - "SUV with low milage great for family of 4 " or "recent model, city car"

Key features:
1. Smart search - Describe your ideal car in natural language
2. Relevant results - Get information about any listing and compare between options
3. Interactive refinement - Ask follow-up questions to narrow your search 

Whether you're a first-time buyer or seasoned car enthusiast, Standvirtual makes car buying as simple as having a conversation.
payload.longDescription:
用日常语言在葡萄牙寻找理想汽车。无需复杂筛选器和搜索表单。使用 Standvirtual，只需描述你想找什么——“适合 4 人家庭的低里程 SUV”或“较新的城市小型车”。

主要功能：
1. 智能搜索——用自然语言描述理想汽车
2. 相关结果——获取任意挂牌信息并比较选项
3. 交互式细化——提出后续问题以缩小范围

无论你是首次购车者还是资深汽车爱好者，Standvirtual 都能让买车像聊天一样简单。

payload.name: Zinde AI Free Calorie Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zinde connects ChatGPT with your Zinde account so you can review daily nutrition, water, steps, exercise, and goal progress in one place. Ask for a daily or weekly summary, get meal suggestions based on your remaining targets, update your goals, and log meals, water, or exercise after reviewing a preview.
payload.longDescription: Zinde 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Zinde 账户，让你在同一处查看每日营养、饮水、步数、运动和目标进度。可以请求每日或每周摘要，根据剩余目标获取饮食建议，更新目标，并在查看预览后记录饮食、饮水或运动。

payload.name: REMAX Turkiye
payload.summaryOriginal: Find homes for sale or rent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search the RE/MAX Türkiye property portfolio without leaving ChatGPT. From homes for sale or rent to commercial spaces and land, browse listings published on remax.com.tr simply by describing what you're looking for in your own words.

Mention @REMAX Turkiye and tell it what you need — a three-bedroom apartment in a gated complex in Ataşehir, or a detached house near the coast in İzmir. The app reads your location, budget, room count and other preferences, then returns the listings that match.

Hold one focused question, make one symbolic draw, then confirm it with one symbolic cup action. The source sign poem and traditional note remain in Chinese, with a detailed interpretation in Chinese and faithful English.

Users may optionally save a JPEG card for the exact sign they drew. The service processes only inputs needed to return the reading and does not persist ritual sessions.

Read a briefing for your saved artist roster, then explore an individual artist’s songs, stations, and trends.

payload.longDescription:

payload.name: Triad Astro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Triad Astro reads your birth chart in three astrological traditions at once - Western (Tropical), Vedic (Sidereal), and Chinese (BaZi / Four Pillars) - and shows you where they agree.

Give it a birth date, plus a time and place if you know them, and it calculates all three charts in a single step: Sun, Moon and rising signs, planetary aspects and elemental balance from the Western system; Nakshatra, Navamsa, planetary dignity and the Vimshottari Dasha timeline from the Vedic system; and the Four Pillars, Day Master and ten-year Luck Pillars from the Chinese system.

Most astrology tools give you one system's answer. Triad Astro gives you three, then helps you read the overlap - the themes that show up independently in all three are the ones worth a closer look.

Planetary positions are computed from ephemeris data aligned to NASA JPL standards, and birth places are resolved to coordinates with automatic timezone handling, so charts are accurate to the minute when the birth time is known. Ambiguous place names can be looked up first so you can confirm the right city.

No account or sign-in is required. Just ask for a reading - for example: "Calculate my tri-system birth chart. I was born March 14, 1990 at 7:45am in Bangalore, India."
payload.longDescription:
Triad Astro 同时依据 3 种占星传统解读你的出生星盘——西方占星（回归黄道）、吠陀占星（恒星黄道）和中国命理（八字/四柱）——并展示它们的共通之处。

提供出生日期；如果知道，也提供出生时间和地点。它会一次性计算这 3 张星盘：西方体系的太阳、月亮和上升星座、行星相位及元素平衡；吠陀体系的纳克沙特拉、Navamsa、行星尊贵状态及 Vimshottari Dasha 时间线；以及中国体系的四柱、日主和十年大运。

大多数占星工具只给出一种体系的解读。Triad Astro 会提供 3 种解读，并帮助你查看其重叠之处——那些在 3 种体系中各自独立出现的主题，值得进一步关注。

行星位置依据符合 NASA JPL 标准的星历数据计算；出生地点会解析为坐标并自动处理时区，因此在已知出生时间时，星盘时间可精确到分钟。遇到含义不明确的地名时，可先查询并确认正确城市。

无需账户或登录。只需请求解读，例如：“计算我的三体系出生星盘。我出生于 1990 年 March 14 日上午 7:45，地点是 India 的 Bangalore。”

payload.name: TNT Sweeper

The first reveal and its surrounding tiles are protected. Play with touch, mouse, or keyboard, and start another field using New game in the component. Unfinished runs expire after 60 minutes. payload.name: WhatsTheID
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Ask what was played in a set, which track is playing at a given moment of a video, which sets a track has been played in, or what a channel has uploaded recently. Answers come from WhatsTheID's public tracklists, with links to the full tracklist and to the exact moment on YouTube.

Estimated times are marked as estimates. If a set is not on WhatsTheID yet, the assistant says so and gives a link to add it; it never guesses a tracklist.

Tools:
- Search DJ sets: find sets by DJ, event, festival, club, channel or genre.
- Get set tracklist: the full tracklist of one set from its YouTube link.
- Find track at timestamp: the track playing at a moment like 42:10, with the previous and next tracks.
- Search tracks: find a track and the sets it was played in.
- Latest sets from a channel: a channel's newest sets with tracklists.

Read-only, with no account needed. Each answer is small (one tracklist or up to ten results) and links back to whatstheid.com.
payload.longDescription:
WhatsTheID将您的助手连接至其收录的YouTube DJ混音曲目数据库。您可以询问某个混音集中播放了哪些曲目，视频特定时刻正在播放的曲目，某首曲目曾出现在哪些混音集中，或某频道最近上传了哪些内容。答案来自WhatsTheID的公开曲目列表，并附有完整曲目列表链接以及YouTube上的具体时间点链接。

每首曲目都会标注可信度信息：显示为已识别或未知ID，以及该曲目是来自上传者自有的曲目列表、YouTube音乐识别、听众评论，还是WhatsTheID的音频识别结果。预估时间会标注为预估时间。如果某个混音集尚未收录在WhatsTheID中，助手会明确说明并提供添加链接；绝不会猜测曲目列表。

- 获取混音集曲目列表：通过YouTube链接获取某个混音集的完整曲目列表。
- 通过时间戳查找曲目：查找如42:10这样的特定时刻正在播放的曲目，包含前后曲目信息。
- 搜索曲目：查找某首曲目及其出现的混音集。
- 查看频道最新混音集：展示某频道最新上传的混音集及其曲目列表。

payload.longDescription: CarGene通过一个精心整理的数据库回答关于日本汽车历史的问题：某款车型经历了哪些代际、何时上市、车架代码是什么、开发它们的工程师是谁、各代际之间有何关联（如后续代际、同级车型或衍生车型），以及按国家和年份统计的销售数据。每个事实都标明了来源。只读模式，无需账户。

payload.name: KiedyKoncert
payload.description: KiedyKoncert.pl 是波兰的演唱会日历
payload.longDescription:
KiedyKoncert.pl 是波兰的演唱会日历。该插件允许您询问助手，某位选定的艺人何时演出，某个城市或周边地区在特定日期有哪些演唱会，以及具体演唱会的详细信息。

功能包括：
- 根据艺人或活动名称（支持拼写修正）、城市及10-100公里半径范围、日期或快捷方式（"今天"、"本周末"、"下个月"）以及音乐类型搜索即将举行的演唱会；
- 展示艺人巡演的所有已公布日期及取消场次；
- 显示演唱会详细信息：艺人名称、日期、入场和开场时间（如有）、场地和地址、状态（包括售罄、取消、延期）、票价起始价及票务供应商名称；
- 列出各音乐类型对应的即将举行演唱会数量。

数据来源为俱乐部、场馆和文化中心的官方日历以及票务供应商。每个演唱会都会注明来源和最后确认日期。

插件不支持以下功能：
- 仅支持只读模式：不购买门票、不创建账户、不修改数据也不保存提醒；
- 不提供票务链接——每个演唱会均跳转至 KiedyKoncert.pl 的专属页面，该页面显示当前票务供应商；
- 仅涵盖波兰境内的演唱会，且日期从当天开始；
- 若日历中无演唱会会直接提示（"暂无即将举行的演唱会"），不会进行推测。

数据更新频率取决于来源方——出行前建议再次向主办方确认最新状态。

payload.name: Inkspired
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inkspired is a platform where authors write and publish serialized stories and build the universes behind them. This connector gives your AI assistant access to your own Inkspired author workspace, so it can help you write, revise and understand your work without copy-pasting.


What it can do:



Browse your work: list your stories and open any chapter, including drafts.

Draft and revise: create new stories and chapter drafts, and save changes to drafts.

Proofread safely: suggest corrections that you review and apply. Every change an assistant makes to a chapter is backed up first, so you can restore the previous version.

Build your world: create universes, link stories to them, and add, update or link glossary entries for characters, places and lore.

Understand your readers: read the comments and reviews on your chapters, see your writing stats, and view story performance. Performance includes reads, likes, retention and drop-off, demographics and rankings, within the limits of your plan.

Stay on top of activity: check your recent notifications.


What it can't do: it can never publish, schedule or delete anything. Those actions stay with you on Inkspired. It only has access to your own account, you approve its permissions when you connect, and you can disconnect it at any time.
payload.longDescription:
Inkspired是一个作者撰写和发布连载故事并构建其世界观的平台。该连接器可让您的人工智能助手访问您的Inkspired作者工作区，从而帮助您撰写、修改和理解作品，而无需复制粘贴。

它能做什么：

浏览您的作品：列出您的故事并打开任何章节，包括草稿。

撰写与修改：创建新故事和章节草稿，并保存草稿修改。

安全校对：提出需要您审阅并应用的修改建议。助手对章节的每次修改都会先进行备份，您可以恢复到之前的版本。

构建您的世界：创建世界观，将故事与之关联，并添加、更新或链接角色、地点和背景设定的术语表条目。

了解您的读者：查看章节的评论和评分，查阅写作数据并观察故事表现。表现数据包括阅读量、点赞数、留存率和流失率、受众统计数据和排名，具体取决于您的计划限制。

掌握活动动态：查看最近的通知。

它无法执行发布、排期或删除操作，这些操作仍由您在Inkspired上处理。它仅访问您的个人账户，连接时您需批准其权限，且可随时断开连接。

payload.name: Reading Your Love
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reading Your Love (RYL) reads the relationship between two people as two gauges: temperature — your drive for romance — and humidity — the depth of feeling for the other person. Give both birth dates and birth cities (birth times sharpen it) and RYL shows an interactive card with where each of you sits on each gauge, named in RYL's own words (Lukewarm / Moderate / Hot, Dry / Moist / Damp). The card is a preview: the exact reading, with the full story behind it, is one tap away on readingyourlove.com, with your details already filled in.
payload.longDescription:
Reading Your Love（RYL）通过两个仪表盘展现两个人的关系：温度——你对浪漫的渴望程度，以及湿度——你对对方情感的深度。
提供双方的出生日期和出生城市（精确的出生时间能提升准确性），RYL会生成一张互动卡片，显示你们在每个仪表盘上的位置，卡片会用RYL特有的词汇进行命名（温热/适中/火热，干燥/湿润/潮湿）。
这张卡片仅作为预览：完整的解读及其中的详细故事，只需轻点一下即可在readingyourlove.com上查看，您的信息已预先填写完毕。

Listen to playable previews and jump to your favorite music service to hear more.

找到与您喜爱的歌曲风格相似的歌曲，探索相似艺术家，理解一首歌曲为何具有特定风格，并发现适合任何情绪、流派、活动或氛围的播放列表。
聆听可播放的试听片段，并跳转至您喜爱的音乐服务以了解更多。
